seo.title: Shipping & Returns - Kibay Espumante
seo.description: Information about Kibay Espumante's shipping policies, delivery areas, and return procedures for our premium wines.

title: Shipping & Returns
intro: We strive to ensure your Kibay experience is perfect from our winery to your glass. Here is what you need to know about our delivery and return processes.

sections.title: 1. Shipping of Alcoholic Products
sections.content: We currently ship to select locations within the Dominican Republic. All orders containing alcohol must be received by an adult of legal drinking age (18+). Valid government-issued photo ID is required upon delivery. Carriers will not leave packages unattended.

sections.title: 2. Shipping Costs
sections.content: Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on the weight of your order and the delivery destination. We may offer free shipping promotions on orders exceeding a certain value. Expedited shipping options may be available for an additional fee.

sections.title: 3. Order Processing
sections.content: Orders are typically processed within 1-2 business days. Orders placed on weekends or holidays will be processed on the following business day. You will receive a confirmation email with tracking information once your order has shipped.

sections.title: 4. Returns Policy for Alcohol
sections.content: Due to legal regulations and the perishable nature of our products, we generally do not accept returns of alcoholic beverages. All sales are considered final. However, we are committed to customer satisfaction and will address issues with damaged or incorrect orders.

sections.title: 5. Damaged or Incorrect Orders
sections.content: If your order arrives damaged, spoiled, or incorrect, please contact us immediately at info@kibay.com.do. Please retain the original packaging and contents. We may request photos of the damage to process a replacement or refund.

sections.title: 6. Cancellations
sections.content: Orders may be cancelled only if they have not yet been processed for shipping. Once an order has been packed and a shipping label created, it cannot be cancelled. Please contact us immediately if you wish to request a cancellation.

sections.title: 7. Lost or Stolen Packages
sections.content: We are not responsible for packages that are lost or stolen after they have been successfully delivered to the address provided. Please ensure someone is available to receive the package, especially given the signature requirement for alcohol.

sections.title: 8. Responsible Delivery
sections.content: Our delivery partners reserve the right to refuse delivery if the recipient appears to be intoxicated or cannot provide valid proof of age. In such cases, the package may be returned to us, and a restocking fee plus return shipping costs may apply.

sections.title: 9. Contact Information
sections.content: For any shipping or return related inquiries, please reach out to our support team at info@kibay.com.do. We are here to ensure you have an excellent experience with Kibay Espumante.

sections.title: 10. Company Information
sections.content: This website and online store are operated by LADISON DOMINICANA SRL, a company duly incorporated under the laws of the Dominican Republic, with National Taxpayer Registry (RNC) number 131128033 and Wine Manufacturing License VINO-022 issued by the Dominican Internal Revenue Service (DGII) on 17 June 2023, currently in force. Registered address: Bahía de Ocoa, Km 6½ Hatillo, Azua 71003, Dominican Republic. Contact: info@kibay.com.do. Kibay is the commercial brand under which LADISON DOMINICANA SRL markets its sustainable sparkling wines.
